title: lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-abelian-lift-hom
statement: Let U,V be schemes [def-pc-scheme], f : U → V, L the set inverse image on the small étale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], La the abelian inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and FaU,FaV the forgetful functors from abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Assume L preserves finite limits. There exists ea : La ⋙ FaU ≅ FaV ⋙ L such that forgetting every adjunct under the abelian inverse/direct-image adjunction [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] equals the set adjunct after precomposing with ea inverse. No operation compatibility is asserted.

source.place: Proposition 00YV, proof of (2) and its paragraph on rings; discussion of quadruples and sextuples in Section 00YR; Example 00X2 and uniqueness of adjoints

proof.text: Form the set inverse/direct-image adjunction a for continuous etale base change. The finite-limit hypothesis on its left functor gives the canonical finite-product braided structure; the right functor preserves products by precomposition. Apply Mathlib Adjunction.mapCommGrp to lift a to internal commutative group objects.

Obtain eV,eU,iV,iU and the right square beta with its underlying equation from etaleAbelianDirectImageInternal. Define Lt = eV.functor followed by L.mapCommGrp followed by eU.inverse. The counit isomorphism of eU gives q:eV.functor L.mapCommGrp iso Lt eU.functor. Restrict the lifted adjunction along the fully faithful eV and eU using q and beta, obtaining aLift:Lt adjoint Ra.

Compose the inverse underlying comparison iU with q inverse, the strict underlying comparison of mapCommGrp, and iV to obtain gamma:Lt FaU iso FaV L. For any t:Lt G to F, map the restricted adjunct by eV and then by CommGrp.forget. The map_preimage formula gives the original lifted adjunct followed by beta. Its underlying map is the set adjunct by the unit formula for Adjunction.mapCommGrp. Use the underlying equation for beta and naturality of iV to replace the right factor by R(iU_F). The naturality equations of the set homEquiv in both arguments, cancellation of L(iV_G) with L(iV_G inverse), and naturality of iU give FaV(aLift(t)) = a(gamma inverse followed by FaU(t)). Each equality is written and checked in Lean.

Let aa be the recorded abelian inverse/direct-image adjunction. Choose e=aa.leftAdjointUniq aLift, and set ea=(e whiskered with FaU) followed by gamma. For t=e inverse followed by h, the unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app equation gives aLift(t)=aa(h). Substitute this in the preceding hom-set equation and expand the inverse of the composite iso to obtain exactly the claimed equation.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleInverseImageAbelianLift_hom (U V : Scheme.{u}) (f : U ⟶ V)
    (hL : PreservesFiniteLimits (Scheme.etaleSetPullback f)) :
    let b := MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f
    let L := Scheme.etaleSetPullback f
    let La := Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f
    let FaU := sheafForget (D := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) U.smallEtaleTopology
    let FaV := sheafForget (D := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) V.smallEtaleTopology
    let a := Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous b
      (Type (u + 1)) (V.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
      (U.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
    ∃ (ea : La ⋙ FaU ≅ FaV ⋙ L),
        (∀ (G : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
            (F : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (h : La.obj G ⟶ F),
          FaV.map ((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).homEquiv
            G F h) =
              a.homEquiv (FaV.obj G) (FaU.obj F) (ea.inv.app G ≫ FaU.map h))
